svg.title: Where neon may go
svg.text: Neon / UV face paint only in the dashed green zones; never in the red hatched eye area. Lesson 06.4, project 7.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Neon / UV face paint (if the label allows): forehead, temples, cheeks, jaw, body
Eye area (brows, eyelids, under the eyes): no fluorescent, UV or glow-in-the-dark paint
Near the eyes use only ordinary, non-fluorescent paint whose label allows the eye area.
